patches.before:
\- Voice agents and assistants: Stream microphone audio, use partial results to detect emerging intent, and act on finalized text once the utterance is complete.

\- Live captions and subtitles: Display partial recognition results immediately, then replace them with stable final text as each utterance completes.

\- Contact center agent assistance: Stream call audio and use finalized utterances to retrieve knowledge, populate forms, summarize context, and recommend next-best actions while the call is active.

\- Real-time call analytics: Send finalized utterances to analytics and monitoring systems throughout the session to flag topics, intent, sentiment, compliance terms, or escalation risk.

\- Real-time dictation: Render partial text as the user speaks and commit final results to the document with minimal perceived delay.

\- Meeting and collaboration experiences: Process meeting audio continuously and make finalized utterances available to captions, notes, search, and summarization.

\- Interactive accessibility tools: Convert live audio into continuously updated partial captions and stable final text across supported languages.

\- Live media and broadcasts: Stream program audio to feed captions, moderation, live blogs, indexing, or translation workflows.

\- Live translation workflows: Pass stable final utterances to downstream translation or speech synthesis as speakers complete each phrase.

\- Customer service automation: Stream caller speech and route finalized requests to intent detection, workflow automation, or a human agent.

patches.before:
You can call the model in one of two ways, depending on your preferred setup:

\- OpenAI Realtime-compatible API over WebSockets: a drop-in option if you already build against the Realtime API, so existing integration patterns carry over with minimal changes.

\- Azure Speech SDK: a drop-in option if you already build using the Azure Speech SDK.

MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming is available in the following Azure regions:

\- Central US

• East US 2 (Coming soon)

\- Sweden Central

\- Southeast Asia
